title: Core-26 Canonical Object Reconciliation
objective: Materialize and reconcile current-authority SpeciesDefinition records for all 26, including Morganthyr identity migration, Rog/Suula base objects and Akwi canonical-catalog convergence without duplicating governed mechanics.
acceptance: 26/26 current canonical species identities resolve to exact-version SpeciesDefinition authority
26/26 Core-26 species have permanent versioned canon registers and source-chain directories for future lore/mechanics/canon updates
no current species-definition catalog exposes Nekron/Nekrons as canonical; Nekron is a historical alias resolving to Morganthyr
Akwi resolves as a Core-26 peer through the canonical database without duplicating the governed AKWI-01 rules path
Rog and Suula have source-backed current SpeciesDefinition objects
ManyToms owner-approved dossier is a real canonical replacement source and is discoverable/rebuildable through the source registry
all 26 current objects are bound to CORE26-CURRENT-01 and CORE26.GAME_READY.v1
canonical database rebuild deterministically materializes the 26 definitions, 26 registers, and historical alias provenance
boundaries: MVPS-18 reconciles identity, exact-version objects, canonical registers and durable source chains; it does not claim the 26 are mechanically complete or game-ready certified.
Future species canon work appends versioned register/source files and rebuilds the canonical database; prior source versions are preserved.
Do not fabricate absent lore or mechanics merely to populate a register.
Preserve sealed historical 25-profile and Nekron evidence; current Morganthyr identity is additive migration authority.
Reuse AKWI-01 governed integration and source-backed Rog/Suula material; do not create parallel rules engines.
Ratman lineages remain subordinate and are not peer Core-26 species.
next_action: MVPS-19 is the strict successor. It must consume the exact-version Core-26 SpeciesDefinitions and permanent per-species canon registers/source chains rather than recreating identity or provenance.
